system.description: When you roll for a carrying, climbing, jumping, or smashing task and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) While bigger than normal, each size increment (Enlarge, Bigger, Huge, Gargantuan, and Colossal) increases this minimum number rolled by 3. This ability renews when you take a recovery. Enabler. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 12.
